headline: Three Key Projects for Azerbaijan's "Green Energy" Export to Europe Are Progressing Successfully – Alparslan Bayraktar (INTERVIEW)
summary: Energy cooperation between Azerbaijan and Türkiye is entering a new stage, with the parties discussing major regional renewable electricity projects, according to an interview with Alparslan Bayraktar.
why: Renewable electricity export links between producers and European markets shape long-term energy supply and investment.
